description: Ground-truth environment rules for EvoPolicyGym counterfactual explanation generation

rules.name: Collision Avoidance
rules.description: Agent must not collide with static obstacles
rules.correction_hint: Adjust trajectory to maintain minimum safe distance from obstacles

rules.name: Boundary Compliance
rules.description: Agent must remain within environment boundaries
rules.condition: position.x in [min_x, max_x] and position.y in [min_y, max_y]
rules.correction_hint: Steer away from environment boundaries when approaching edges

rules.name: Goal Achievement
rules.description: Agent must reach the designated goal within time limit
rules.correction_hint: Optimize path planning to reach goal faster

rules.name: Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
rules.description: Agent must avoid moving obstacles during navigation
rules.correction_hint: Predict obstacle trajectory and adjust path accordingly

rules.name: Energy Efficiency
rules.correction_hint: Use smoother control inputs to reduce energy expenditure

rules.name: Dynamic Shift Adaptation
rules.description: Agent must adapt to environmental changes after shift_step
rules.correction_hint: Implement online learning or rapid policy adjustment after detecting environmental shift

rules.name: Counterfactual Consistency
rules.description: Generated explanations must reference actual violated rules
rules.correction_hint: Validate explanation against rule schema before returning
